Subject: Supabase Auth SMTP guide and the 30/hour limit
Preview text: See the Resend setup path; adjust Supabase’s hourly Auth limit separately.

Supabase Auth can send through Resend.

Hi there,

Supabase Auth’s email sender and its Auth rate limit are separate settings.

If you use Supabase Auth, Resend is available as an email sending platform for its messages through custom SMTP. Our Supabase guide shows where to enable SMTP and where to get Resend credentials. You can inspect that path before creating an account or changing Auth settings.

Configuring custom SMTP routes those messages through Resend. Supabase still applies its own Auth limit after the change: initially 30 messages per hour, adjustable separately in Supabase’s Rate Limits settings. Connecting a sender does not raise that setting for you.

Resend’s plan limit is separate again. Free allows 100 emails per day; Pro has no daily sending limit. The guide gives you the setup steps to decide whether this SMTP route fits your project.

Read the Supabase SMTP guide →

- the Resend team
